create_weibull_distribution: create a Weibull distribution with scale and concentration parameters for sampling
sample_weibull_distribution: sample from a Weibull distribution given scale and concentration tensors
compute_weibull_mean: compute the mean of a Weibull distribution using scale and concentration parameters
